_doc: Helper lane registry (iMac). dispatch.mjs claims only role primary or failover. One lane = port + profile + launcher + owner. Never point a second tool at a lane profile. Helper chat works from either account, so dispatch lanes sign in as robbagley@ensign.edu. ecenter24@ensign.net lanes are role manual, for Copilot Studio maker work only (Rob 2026-09-30, replaces the 2026-09-29 ecenter24-only rule). Plists must set AbandonProcessGroup true. Stop lanes only with lane_stop.mjs.

lanes.name: edge1
lanes.note: General CIS work and helper chat dispatch lane, robbagley@ensign.edu, on Microsoft Edge Beta since 2026-10-16 (profile name "EDGE 1"). The old stable-Edge profile claude-ensign-helper-edge1-profile ("Profile 2") stays as a backup until Rob approves retiring it. Its Profile 3 is personal gmail: never use it.

lanes.name: edge3
lanes.note: Failover helper chat dispatch lane on Microsoft Edge Beta, robbagley@ensign.edu (Rob 2026-10-16). Shares the account quota with edge1, so it adds failover, not throughput.

lanes.name: edge2
lanes.note: Maker lane, ecenter24@ensign.net, profile "CoPilot Studio": Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Power Apps maker work only (changing or fixing the helper or another agent). Never dispatch helper chats here (Rob 2026-09-30). Edge Beta since 2026-10-16, all sync types off, --disable-extensions. The old stable profile claude-ensign-helper-edge2-profile stays as a backup (sync off) until Rob approves retiring it.

lanes.name: chrome9226
lanes.note: Rob's own helper chats and drive.mjs default. Dispatcher never claims it.

lanes.name: chrome9227
lanes.note: Signed-in spare Chrome (launch-persistent-chrome-helper2.sh). No script targets it. drive.mjs with CDP_PORT=9227 for a one-off chat only.

qwen.note: Local Qwen on the Mac Studio. Not a lane: no browser, no lock here. Slots: qwen.mjs locks/qwen.
